goal: A new flywheel-cli workspace package (interim dist flywheel-cli, module flywheel_cli, console script fw only) routes init, worker [--once], status [--json], live [--watch], say, interrupt, approve, reject, archive, recover, recheck-blocked, and audit to their existing implementations, and bare fw (or --json/non-TTY) launches the existing flywheel-tui console or snapshot.

relevant: .flywheel/specs/00021-FEATURE-unified-cli.md -- FR-4 and FR-7 are this task's surface; the Decisions Log fixes the interim naming
packages/flywheel/src/flywheel/workflow.py -- the say/interrupt/approve/reject/audit producer verbs to delegate to
packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/worker.py -- the daemon loop behind fw worker [--once]
pyproject.toml -- workspace root: register flywheel-cli under [tool.uv.sources], the dev group, and testpaths
references: packages/flywheel-tui/pyproject.toml -- mirror this downstream-package pyproject shape
packages/flywheel-tui/src/flywheel_tui/_cli.py -- the TTY-vs---json dispatch pattern bare fw must reuse (delegate to it; absorption happens in cli-shell-input)
constraints: Interim naming is deliberate: dir packages/flywheel-cli, dist flywheel-cli, console script fw ONLY -- core still owns the flywheel script until cli-cutover-rename flips both. Do not touch core's script.

Delegate, never reimplement: each subcommand calls the existing implementation (import and invoke; flywheel worker runs the flywheel-worktree daemon loop in-process, not via shell-out). Output and exit codes must match the originals.
Exposing run, next, or bare orchestrate as fw subcommands is forbidden -- they stay python -m plumbing per the spec's lean-surface decision.
Store-path resolution goes through the public load_effective_policy/resolve_db_path seams from spec 00020; do not duplicate resolution logic.
Package depends on flywheel-orchestrator, flywheel-worktree, and (interim, removed next task) flywheel-tui.
Existing flywheel-orchestrate/flywheel-worktree/flywheel-tui scripts keep working unchanged in this task.
Run mcp__ide__getDiagnostics on every .py file touched and fix all Pylance errors in the same turn.
Commit with a Conventional Commits feat: message before emitting intent=verify.
non_goals: No slash commands or input-bar work (cli-shell-input).
No worker liveness detection or supervision (cli-worker-supervision).
edge_cases: fw <verb> --help must work without a store present.
Subcommands needing a store follow the existing per-command behavior for a missing store in this task; the spec's unified no-store message lands with the cutover.

graders.run: uv run fw --help >/dev/null && uv run fw worker --help >/dev/null && uv run fw status --help >/dev/null && uv run fw approve --help >/dev/null
graders.name: help-wiring
